children: , the consumer-electronics, software and digital-services giant, climbed approximately 2.5% to $324.71 Tuesday as its trade-secret fight with OpenAI moved deeper into federal court. OpenAI wants Apple's case thrown out, denying that former employees carried confidential hardware, manufacturing and supply-chain information into its growing consumer-device business.

The talent drain is real. Reuters reported that OpenAI has recruited roughly 400 Apple employees for its hardware operation. Apple claims two former engineers accessed internal files after leaving, while OpenAI says it never obtained Apple's trade secrets and blames the dispute on Apple's own document controls and employee-departure procedures.

Apple is spending heavily to protect its innovation engine. Quarterly research and development expenses surged 32% to $11.73 billion, an increase of $2.86 billion. The chart shows the stock trading 14.22% above its $284.29 GF Value estimate, signaling that investors are already pricing in substantial future execution. Four hundred departures will not break Applebut losing specialized hardware expertise to an AI rival is far more important than the headline number alone suggests.

title: Apple Climbs Nearly 2.5% as OpenAI Fights Claims After 400 Hires
